verified_facts.text: The resort is set amid AlUla's sandstone canyons and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set amidst AlUla’s breathtaking sandstone canyons and UNESCO World Heritage sites

verified_facts.text: The resort sits in Ashar Valley, a 20-minute drive from AlUla town.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort sits in Ashar Valley, a 20-minute drive from AlUla town

verified_facts.text: The villas are sustainably designed to embrace the natural surroundings of the Ashar Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our villas are sustainably designed to embrace the natural surroundings of the Ashar Valley.

verified_facts.text: All villas have canyon views, private outdoor lounge decks, king-sized beds and indoor and outdoor showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our villas offer scenic canyon views, private outdoor lounge decks, king-sized beds, indoor & outdoor showers

verified_facts.text: Celestial Villas feature telescopes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Celestial Villas feature telescopes and host spacious areas for lounging

verified_facts.text: The Art Villas have views of one of the Desert X installations, such as Falling Stones Garden and Najma.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Celestial and Canyon Art Villas tap into our creative spirit with views of one of the Desert X installations, including Falling Stones Garden and Najma.

verified_facts.text: The Arabian Villas are the resort's largest and most secluded accommodations, with views of the Ashar Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Arabian Villas are our largest and most secluded accommodations, featuring pristine views of the sweeping Ashar Valley

verified_facts.text: Thuraya Wellness has a lounge with an alchemy bar, spa treatment rooms, a fitness center, an outdoor wellness agora and a yoga studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thuraya Wellness offers a peaceful lounge space with an alchemy bar, spa treatment rooms, a fitness center, an outdoor wellness agora, and a yoga studio.

verified_facts.text: Guests get a complimentary daily programming schedule built around art and culture, wellness, adventure, learning, food and beverage, and music.
verified_facts.excerpt: we offer our guests a complimentary daily programming schedule centered around our six pillars: Art & Culture, Wellness, Adventure, Learning, Food & Beverage and Music.

verified_facts.text: Guests can hike the resort's 8km Adventure Trail and stargaze with a local expert.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hike our 8km Adventure Trail and historical treasure site, stargaze with a local expert under the clear night sky

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a Hegra day tour to Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, with Nabataean tombs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore Saudi Arabia’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site of well-preserved Nabataean tombs

verified_facts.text: Stargazing at Gharameel pairs the desert rock formations with dinner outdoors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the enchantment of desert, surrounded by Gharameel’s mystical rock formations, and enjoy dinner alfresco.

verified_facts.text: The infinity pool is set against the cliff at the head of the valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: the infinity pool pinned precisely against the cliff

verified_facts.text: Tama, the resort's restaurant, takes its name from the Aramaic for 'here and now'.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tama, meaning ‘here and now’ in Aramaic

verified_facts.text: Tama's menu ingredients come from local farms in communities around AlUla.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ingredients in our menus are sourced from local farms in communities surrounding AlUla

verified_facts.text: The resort's programming includes sunrise yoga on the Ashar Deck and live music featuring local talent.
verified_facts.excerpt: From sunrise yoga on our Ashar Deck to live music featuring local talent

verified_facts.text: Several Desert X AlUla installations are dotted across the valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Several colourful Desert X AlUla installations by the likes of Lita Albuquerque and Manal Aldowayan are dotted across the valley

verified_facts.text: All villas are on the ground floor and not accessible via lifts.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our villas are located on the ground floor and not accessible via lifts.

verified_facts.text: Rollaway beds are not available at this time.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rollaway beds are not available at this time.

verified_facts.text: Professional photography and drone use are prohibited at the property without prior approval.
verified_facts.excerpt: Professional photography and drone usage is strictly prohibited at Our Habitas AlUla and Caravan by Habitas AlUla properties without prior approval.

verified_facts.text: Habitas AlUla opened in November 2021.
verified_facts.excerpt: Habitas AlUla, which opened in November 2021

verified_facts.text: Free electric bicycles are available for getting around the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: free electric bicycles make exploring effortless
